description: 국토교통부_교통안전_교통시설 안전진단 정보(도로) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 교통시설안전진단(도로)이란 도로의 설계단계와 운영단계에서 도로 및 교통시설의 안전결함요인에 대한 진단으로 교통사고요인을 사전에 제거하여 교통사고를 예방하고 교통사고의 심각도를 감소시키는데. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 도로등급, 고속도로, 일반국도, 진단실적, 도로별. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
